title: Keep score
subtitle: Chapter 5 of 9
instructions: Warm and plain spoken, like a friend showing you their app. Brisk and light on its feet, keeping things moving, but never rushed or clipped. No salesy lift at the end of sentences.

lines.text: Keep score is a PongLens screen built for one job: scoring a whole match far faster than watching it back.
It plays the match one point at a time and waits for you.
Watch the rally, then tap who won it. The score keeps itself.
The lit ball shows who is serving. Tap it to hand the serve over if it got that wrong.
Tap Why to note what went wrong.
Swipe left on the pad to add a note or a tag to the point without breaking your rhythm.
If a game ended somewhere the app did not expect, you can end it here yourself, or tap the divider in the point strip to undo one it got wrong.
Skip a let, cut dead space, or split a clip that caught two points.
Every point you score feeds your scorecard, your stats, and your placement maps.
